trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer (Frontier)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P network peer propagating blocks. Block headers must be validated (difficulty, gas limit, timestamp), transactions executed, and state root verified before acceptance.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter (Frontier)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External account submitting signed transactions. Full validation required: ECDSA signature, nonce match, sufficient balance for gas * gasPrice + value.

trusted_external_entities.name: Remote Peer Node (Typed Tx)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer sending transactions via devp2p. Unknown TransactionType or invalid payload SHOULD trigger peer disconnection. Fork activation timing must be respected.

trusted_external_entities.name: Message Signer (CHAINID)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External user who signed a message potentially on a different chain. Chain ID in signature must match current chain via CHAINID opcode to prevent replay attacks.

trusted_external_entities.name: PoW Miner
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Proof-of-Work miner producing blocks before the merge. Total difficulty calculated from miner blocks must be validated to correctly identify terminal block for PoS transition.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain (Consensus Layer)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Consensus layer providing fork choice updates and execution payloads post-merge. Authenticated via Engine API. Provides head/safe/finalized block hashes. Must validate deprecated fields (difficulty=0, nonce=0, empty ommers).

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Execution Node (Gossip)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers sending NewBlock/NewBlockHashes messages. After first PoS finalization, these messages must be silently ignored as gossip is deprecated.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full block validation required: header validation (parent hash, difficulty, gas limit, timestamp), transaction execution, and state root verification. Invalid blocks rejected.
Transaction validation: ECDSA signature verification, sender address recovery, nonce check, balance check for upfront gas cost + value.
TransactionType byte (0-0x7f) must be known. Unknown types trigger peer disconnection. Payload validated per type-specific rules. Fork activation timing enforced.
Signed message must include chain ID. Contract compares signature chain ID against CHAINID opcode result. Mismatch indicates cross-chain replay attempt.
Total difficulty computed to detect terminal block. When totalDifficulty >= TTD (58750000000000000000000), block is marked as terminal and PoS transition begins.
Post-merge blocks must have difficulty=0, nonce=0, empty ommers, zero mixHash. Any invalid deprecated field causes block rejection.
Fork choice updates from consensus layer set canonical head and finalized block. Execution layer trusts beacon chain for LMD-GHOST fork choice decisions.
NewBlock/NewBlockHashes processed only before first PoS finalization. After finalization, messages silently ignored as gossip is deprecated.
